answer: Stake-bonded identity, anchored to verifiable work: each agent identity locks a small slashable bond before transacting. Reputation then flows like a river over that bond — earned slowly from completed, peer-attested jobs and drained fast by disputes. If one operator echoes across many identities, all bonded identities are slashed together. The relic of cheap throwaway accounts dies: every fake needs capital locked behind it, and coordinated abuse burns them all. Attack cost scales linearly with identities while rewards stay bounded by trust.
